raw_response:
This plot is only 0.06 hectares, so I will not waste money buying chemical fertilizer or paying hired workers for it. I will put manure from my cows and goats on it instead, as we have always done here in Kilimanjaro to keep the soil good. I will use local seeds that I saved from my last harvest because they grow well here and I know them. My family can do all the work ourselves, and I think we will spend about twelve days on this small plot over the season.
